description: The main window may call exactly the application's own commands. No core webview, window, filesystem, shell, HTTP, or plugin APIs are exposed to the frontend: the dialog and opener plugins are driven from Rust only. Backup-check, extraction-check, import and verify progress reaches the webview through an IPC channel passed to open_backup, check_extraction, start_import or verify_archive, and exact-text search progress through one passed to search_messages; channels need no core:* permission.
